description.value:
Grave gowns look like flowing formalwear used in funeral rites across the Universe. If you die wearing a grave gown, your corpse is affected by a 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Peaceful Rest] spell.

Activate—In Memoriam f (healing, vitality)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You gain the dying condition

Effect The silk threads of the grave gown glow with supernatural power. Allies within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] regain @Damage[7d8[healing]|options:area-damage] Hit Points and gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls for 1 round. You use this reaction before you lose the ability to act.
